name: Zoom Consistency Routing
notes: The repository describes capture, analysis and leaderboard-submission scripts plus saved predictions. Its setup uses KV-Ground-8B and Qwen3.5-27B and specifies a GPU with at least 80GB VRAM. The README declares an MIT license.
summary: A training-free router chooses between visual grounding models using prediction distance from a zoom crop's center. The release includes ScreenSpot-Pro evaluation scripts.
